# 1.38.0-beta.6

The sixth beta is a cleanup release: a smoother start, a new provider and fixes found during a code review.

## Startup

- The What's new window no longer stutters while it appears. Settings used to be prepared in the background at the same moment, and each step held the window longer than one frame. That work now waits until you close the window.

## Models

- Polza.ai is a built-in provider with its own model list. Its prices are in rubles: set the ruble rate on the Keys and spending page to see approximate dollar amounts, marked with ≈. Without a rate only tokens are counted.
- The Qwen logo is back to its previous look.

## Session panel

- The working sign of an agent no longer starts over every time one of its tools reports progress.

## Under the hood

- Removed code and interface texts left over from the old reasoning picker and other parts that nothing used any more.
